site.title: Bluesky
site.short_description: Decentralized social network with posts, profiles, and threads.
site.long_description: Bluesky supports website links on profiles and in posts. Confirm rel on the live profile URL. Open bsky.app.

opportunities.title: Profile website field
opportunities.description: Set the website URL on your Bluesky profile. Treat outbound social links as nofollow for SEO; value is referral traffic and brand discovery.

opportunities.title: Brand account for business
opportunities.description: Create a separate Bluesky account for your brand or company—not your personal login—so customers see a dedicated handle. Set your business website on that account before you post product updates. Outbound links are typically nofollow.

steps.body: Register a new account at bsky.app with a handle that matches your brand. Keep this login separate from your personal account.
steps.title: Create a brand account

steps.body: On the brand profile at bsky.app, tap Edit profile, enter your company site in Website, save, and confirm the link on the public profile.
steps.title: Add your business URL

opportunities.title: Scheduled thread with link
opportunities.description: Publish a multi-post thread with your link in the lead post. Post links on Bluesky should be planned as nofollow for ranking; they still drive clicks.

opportunities.title: Scheduled thread with link
opportunities.description: After your brand profile lists your website, publish a multi-post thread with your link in the first post. You can publish on Bluesky or schedule the thread in OpenQuok once that account is connected.

steps.body: Switch to the Bluesky account you use for your brand (or your personal account if the thread is personal), start a new thread, and put your URL in the first post with a short line of context.
steps.title: Compose a thread with your link

steps.body: Post the thread now or schedule it in OpenQuok if you want one calendar for Bluesky and your other channels.
steps.title: Publish or schedule

opportunities.title: Reply with link
opportunities.description: Reply on Bluesky with a comment and your URL when it fits. On posts you publish, OpenQuok sends an automated reply with your link after your like threshold. Set up plugs after you connect Bluesky.

steps.body: On Bluesky, join a relevant conversation, add a useful reply, and include your URL once when it fits the thread—links are typically nofollow.
steps.title: Reply with a link

steps.body: On posts you publish, connect Bluesky in OpenQuok and attach plug (like threshold + reply with your link). OpenQuok publishes the reply when your rules match.
steps.title: Automate a follow-up on your posts
